## Purpose
The test-plan prompt: realistic, schema-valid inputs a real caller would send, so the plan can hold them to success.

## Responsibilities
- **`SYSTEM`:**
  - return only `{"cases": [{input, note}]}`;
  - 3 valid cases: every parameter; only the required ones; a realistic edge;
  - no parameters that are not in the schema.
- **`user(spec)`:** the function, purpose, data source, input schema and output schema.

## Key elements
`SYSTEM`, `user`.

## Nuances and gotchas
